title: PLA Rocket Force purges and a possible hidden Chinese program

tellings.quote: there were some recent purges in the last few years in like the rocket forces which you know

plain: China's leadership under Xi Jinping has purged people from the country's rocket forces, the branch of its military that runs its missiles, in the last few years, and this could point to a hidden Chinese programme. The researcher Matthew Pines raises this on the show without naming a source, and offers the purges as a hint that China may have secret work of its own on unexplained craft.
